question: From 10 to 12 April 2025, the 9th edition of the Global Technology Summit (GTS) was held in which city?
solution:
```html

The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 9th edition of the **Global Technology Summit (GTS)** was held from **10 to 12 April 2025** in New Delhi.
 
• GTS is organized by the **Ministry of External Affairs (MEA)** in partnership with Carnegie India.
 
• The summit brings together **global technology leaders, policymakers, and innovators** to discuss critical technological advancements and challenges.
 
• The theme of the 2025 summit focused on **“Global Governance in the Age of Technology”**.
 
• It serves as a platform for fostering international collaboration in technology governance and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Technology Summit (GTS):**

 
 
• GTS is an annual flagship event that promotes dialogue on global technology trends and their implications.
 
• The summit emphasizes the importance of **technology-driven solutions for sustainable development**.
 
• It features discussions on topics like AI, cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, and emerging technologies.
 
• Speakers include policymakers, industry leaders, academics, and innovators from across the globe.
 
 
 
• **Carnegie India:**
 
 
• Carnegie India is part of the global network of Carnegie Endowment for International Peace.
 
• It focuses on policy research and analysis in areas such as technology, economy, and international relations.
 
• Collaborates with the Indian government and private entities to address challenges in technology governance.
 
 
 
• **Technology Governance:**
 
 
• Refers to the policies, regulations, and frameworks that ensure responsible use and development of technology.
 
• Involves addressing ethical concerns, data privacy, and equitable access to technology.
 
• Key topics include AI regulation, cybersecurity protocols, and digital inclusion.
 
 
 
• **India’s Role in Global Technology:**
 
 
• India is one of the fastest-growing technology markets, contributing significantly to global IT services.
 
• The government has launched initiatives like **Digital India** to boost digital infrastructure and technological innovation.
 
• India's startup ecosystem ranks among the top globally, fostering innovation in AI, fintech, and healthtech.
